title: feat: implement DatabaseLoader for datasource-backed metadata persistence
body:
ObjectStack metadata only supported memory/filesystem/http loaders — no database persistence. This was the single P0 blocker preventing production deployment (multi-instance sync, platform/user overlay persistence, Studio metadata editing).

### SysMetadataObject (`packages/metadata/src/objects/sys-metadata.object.ts`)

- Formal ObjectStack object definition for the `sys_metadata` table using `ObjectSchema.create()` with `isSystem: true`
- All fields defined using `Field.*` helpers with proper labels, descriptions, and constraints
- Database indexes for `[type, name]` (unique), `[type, scope]`, `[tenant_id]`, `[state]`, `[namespace]`
- Capabilities: `trackHistory`, `apiEnabled` with full CRUD methods, `trash: false`
- Defined in the `@objectstack/metadata` package (not `packages/spec`, which is protocol-only)

### DatabaseLoader (`packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts`)

- Implements `MetadataLoader` with protocol `datasource:`, full CRUD via `IDataDriver`
- Maps to configurable `sys_metadata` table using `MetadataRecordSchema` envelope
- Auto-creates table on first use via `syncSchema` with the `SysMetadataObject` definition (idempotent, once per instance)
- Upsert semantics with `version` increment for optimistic concurrency
- Multi-tenant isolation via `tenantId` filter on all queries
- Graceful degradation: read failures return null/empty, save failures throw descriptive errors

### MetadataManager integration

- Auto-registers `DatabaseLoader` when `config.datasource` + `config.driver` are both set
- `setDatabaseDriver(driver: IDataDriver)` for deferred setup (kernel resolves driver name → instance later)
- Respects `config.tableName` (default: `sys_metadata`)

```typescript
// Immediate setup
const manager = new MetadataManager({
  datasource: 'default',
  driver: myPostgresDriver,
  formats: ['json'],
});

// Or deferred setup (plugin resolves driver from kernel)
const manager = new MetadataManager({ datasource: 'default', formats: ['json'] });
manager.setDatabaseDriver(resolvedDriver);
```

### Tests

35 new tests covering loader operations, auto-configuration, multi-tenant isolation, error handling, and MetadataManager integration. All 139 tests pass (35 new + 104 existing).

### ROADMAP updates

- `packages/metadata/ROADMAP.md` Phase 1 → ✅
- Root `ROADMAP.md` Phase 4a → ✅, P0 blocker resolved

> 
> *This section details on the original issue you should resolve*
> 
> <issue_title>[P0] 实现 Metadata DatabaseLoader，实现数据库持久化元数据</issue_title>
> <issue_description>### 背景说明
> 当前 ObjectStack 的 metadata 服务仅支持 memory��filesystem、http 三种 loader，实现 overlay/customization 只能保存在内存或本地文件，无法满足生产多实例部署、用户/平台定制持久化、大数据量平台运行等关键需求。Spec 层面所有相关 schema 已定义，缺口仅在 datasource-backed DatabaseLoader。
> 
> ### 目标
> - 最小闭环实现 DatabaseLoader，完成 metadata 的数据库持久化和 overlay 管理能力，为前端、平台上线扫清最大阻碍。
> - 支持 platform 及 user 级元数据存储，解锁多用户自定义、平台自定义、任意规模实例间同步可能性。
> 
> ### 需实现内容
> 1. 实现 `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts`：
>    - 遵循 MetadataLoader 接口，并声明 protocol 为 `datasource:`。
>    - 注入 `IDataDriver` 获取物理数据库连接。
>    - 映射到 sys_metadata（可配）表，CRUD 操作，实现 register/get/list/unregister/exists/stat/save 等能力。
>    - 支持 `scope` 字段（system / platform / user）隔离。
>    - ��次使用时自建表结构，后续自动迁移。
> 2. 在 MetadataManager 中自动集成 DatabaseLoader（即 MetadataManagerConfig.datasource 存在时自动启用）。
> 3. 支持 overlay 持久化到数据库，变更事件和 state 管理依赖数据库。
> 4. 编写必要单元及集成测试。
> 5. ROADMAP.md/README 适当同步调整。
> 
> ### 验收标准
> - platform scope 下的元数据能被持久化于数据库
> - user scope 下自定义 overlay 能被存储数据库，支持按 userId 查询
> - 数据库 offline 回落 filesystem/memory loader
>
